text:
monica: FYI I'm starting the v3.4.1 deploy to canary now. Will toggle ff/inference-edge-fallback in staged steps. Please keep an eye on latency and error-rate dashboards.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: service=inference runtime=v3.4.1 target=canary

kai: thanks — what's the ramp plan? any pinned versions for heavy routes?

monica: Ramp: 0% -> 1% (10m) -> 5% (30m) -> 20% (1h) -> 100% (3h). Pin heavy routes to v3.3.9 for first 30m using routing-pin: "pin=heavy=/route/longgen@v3.3.9". Health gates: 95th latency change < +20%, error rate < 0.5% absolute.

james: noted. I'll watch request queues and GPU saturation. If latency spikes >25% for two consecutive 5m windows we rollback and pause flag.

ana: adding a quick smoke test suite to run on canary every 5m. Snippet:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq '.latency'
```

sarah: please also ensure KV cache warm-up. last time we saw cold cache causing thundering. Maybe prefill top-10 prefixes.

monica: good call. running cache-warm job now. If anyone sees model mismatch (tokens truncated / wrong version), reply here. rolling the 5% step in 8m.

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 1% -> 5% completed. Observability: latency +3%, error rate +0.1%. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

kai: Looks clean so far. keep data pinned for 30m then re-evaluate before moving to 20%.

monica: Agreed. If anything, manual rollback command is:
```
deploy rollback inference v3.4.1 --force --reason "latency spike"
```

james: I'll be ready to run that. thumbs up if we proceed to 20% at 35m mark :thumbsup:

ana: :thumbsup: running tests every 5m.

sarah: monitoring cache warming.

monica: Thanks team — will update here at each gate. (reaction :rocket:)
